rules.sentence: Spondylolisthesis: Complete dislocation with anterior displacement of one vertebra on another.
This may increase pressure on spinal nerves, leading to pain in the nerve’s distribution.[7]
Tuberculous spondylitis: Also known as Pott disease.
This is osteomyelitis of the vertebral bodies along with intervertebral discitis caused by advanced tuberculosis.
Symptoms may include weakness of the lower limbs, kyphosis, back pain, fever, and weight loss.[8]
